items.title: From neural development to regenerative medicine: A research journey in stem cell biology, spinal cord repair, and iPSC-based drug discovery.
items.summary: This commemorative article reflects on a research journey spanning neural development, stem cell biology, regenerative medicine, and iPSC-based drug discovery. My early work focused on RNA-mediated regulation in the nervous system, including studies on myelin basic protein gene regulation and the identification and functional characterization of the RNA-binding protein Musashi. These studies contributed to the conceptual foundation of neural stem cell biology and helped establish methods for identifying and isolating neural stem/progenitor cells, including those present in the adult human brain. Building on this foundation, my colleagues and I pursued translational research in spinal cord injury, ranging from analyses of injury pathophysiology and molecular interventions to preclinical studies using rodent and non-human primate models. These efforts ultimately led to the first-in-human clinical study of induced pluripotent stem cell-derived neural stem/progenitor cell transplantation for subacute spinal cord injury. In parallel, we developed patient-derived iPSC platforms for neurological disease modeling and drug discovery, particularly for amyotrophic lateral sclerosis, where iPSC-based screening identified Ropinirole as a therapeutic candidate and enabled reverse translational research linking cellular phenotypes with clinical responses. Looking ahead, I argue that the future of regenerative therapy will depend on the continued integration of developmental biology, stem cell science, disease modeling, rehabilitation, and clinical translation to address unmet medical needs in disorders of the central nervous system.
items.titleZh: 从神经发育到再生医学：干细胞生物学、脊髓修复与iPSC药物发现的研究之旅
items.summaryZh: 本文是作者对其数十年研究工作的回顾性总结，涵盖从基础神经发育生物学到再生医学的完整转化链条。核心内容包括：Musashi等RNA结合蛋白在神经干细胞中的功能；脊髓损伤的病理机制与干预策略；以及利用患者iPSC平台进行ALS药物筛选，成功发现罗匹尼罗并推进至临床试验。作者强调，未来再生医学需要将发育生物学、干细胞科学、疾病建模、康复医学与临床转化紧密结合。
items.insight: 这篇文章由ALS iPSC药物发现领域的核心人物撰写，系统梳理了从基础研究到临床转化的完整路径，特别是罗匹尼罗从iPSC筛选到临床试验的逆向转化过程，为ALS研究者提供了宝贵的经验和方法论参考。

items.abstractZh: 这篇纪念性文章回顾了涵盖神经发育、干细胞生物学、再生医学和iPSC药物发现的研究历程。作者早期的工作聚焦于神经系统中RNA介导的调控，包括髓鞘碱性蛋白基因调控的研究，以及RNA结合蛋白Musashi的鉴定和功能表征。这些研究为神经干细胞生物学的概念基础做出了贡献，并帮助建立了鉴定和分离神经干/祖细胞（包括成人脑中的神经干/祖细胞）的方法。在此基础上，作者及其同事开展了脊髓损伤的转化研究，涵盖损伤病理生理学分析、分子干预，以及使用啮齿动物和非人灵长类模型的临床前研究。这些努力最终促成了诱导多能干细胞来源的神经干/祖细胞移植治疗亚急性脊髓损伤的首次人体临床研究。与此同时，他们开发了患者来源的iPSC平台用于神经系统疾病建模和药物发现，特别是在肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）中，基于iPSC的筛选确定了罗匹尼罗（Ropinirole）作为治疗候选药物，并实现了将细胞表型与临床反应联系起来的反向转化研究。展望未来，作者认为再生治疗的未来将依赖于发育生物学、干细胞科学、疾病建模、康复和临床转化的持续整合，以解决中枢神经系统疾病中未满足的医疗需求。
items.frontierRationale: 该文发表于2026年，由领域内权威研究者总结其从神经发育到iPSC药物发现的完整研究历程，其中包含ALS iPSC药物筛选和临床试验的最新进展，具有高度的ALS相关性和转化价值。

items.title: Pathology of general proprioception in a canine disease model of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis.
items.summary: Some forms of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) are associated with sequence variants in the superoxide dismutase 1 gene (SOD1). The mechanisms by which these variants contribute to ALS disease pathogenesis are poorly understood. Degenerative myelopathy (DM), a naturally occurring canine disease, shares similarities with some forms of SOD1-associated ALS, especially cases with sensory impairment. While motor pathway involvement in ALS has been extensively studied, sensory pathology has received comparatively less attention. To investigate whether pathology in the general proprioceptive pathway is associated with pelvic limb general proprioceptive ataxia, an early DM sign, we examined sensory system components of this pathway from Pembroke Welsh Corgis with early- and late-stage DM and age-matched controls. The disease was characterized by axonal pathology in the spinocerebellar tracts and the fasciculus gracilis, pronounced accumulation of SOD1-positive inclusions in nucleus thoracicus and dorsal root ganglia (DRG) neurons, and altered SOD1 immunolabeling in dorsal and ventral root axons and ensheathing myelin. Axonal pathology was also observed in a pelvic limb sensory nerve. These findings suggest that pathology in the proprioceptive sensory pathways may play a significant role in general proprioceptive ataxia in DM. Some dogs that were homozygous for the SOD1 risk allele did not develop clinical disease or the associated neuropathology, indicating that other factors in addition to the SOD1 mutation influence disease onset and progression.
items.titleZh: 犬肌萎缩侧索硬化疾病模型中一般本体感觉的病理学
items.summaryZh: 这项研究利用自然发生的犬类退行性脊髓病（DM）作为SOD1相关ALS的模型，首次系统性地检查了一般本体感觉通路（包括脊髓小脑束、薄束、胸核和背根神经节）的病理变化。研究发现，这些感觉通路中的轴突病理和SOD1阳性包涵体积累与犬只的共济失调症状相关。值得注意的是，部分携带SOD1风险等位基因纯合子的犬只并未发病，提示疾病外显率受其他因素调控。
items.insight: 该研究填补了ALS研究中感觉通路病理相对被忽视的空白，为理解SOD1突变如何导致非运动症状（如感觉障碍）提供了直接的病理学证据，并提示本体感觉通路可能是潜在的治疗靶点或生物标志物来源。

aiRead.limitation: 研究为观察性病理描述，样本量可能有限，且犬类DM与人类ALS的病理差异需进一步明确；未探讨病理改变与功能丧失之间的因果关系。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注后续研究是否鉴定出除SOD1突变外的疾病修饰因素，以及本体感觉通路病理是否在人类ALS患者中得到验证，并探索其作为治疗靶点的可能性。

items.abstractZh: 某些形式的肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）与超氧化物歧化酶1基因（SOD1）的序列变异有关。这些变异导致ALS疾病发病机制的机制尚不明确。退行性脊髓病（DM）是一种自然发生的犬类疾病，与某些形式的SOD1相关ALS（尤其是伴有感觉障碍的病例）具有相似性。虽然ALS中运动通路的受累已被广泛研究，但感觉病理学受到的关注相对较少。为了研究一般本体感觉通路中的病理是否与骨盆肢体一般本体感觉性共济失调（DM的早期体征）相关，我们检查了来自彭布罗克威尔士柯基犬的该通路的感觉系统组成部分，这些犬包括早期和晚期DM以及年龄匹配的对照组。该疾病的特征在于脊髓小脑束和薄束中的轴突病理、胸核和背根神经节（DRG）神经元中SOD1阳性包涵体的显著积累，以及背根和腹根轴突及其包裹髓鞘中SOD1免疫标记的改变。在骨盆肢体的感觉神经中也观察到轴突病理。这些发现表明，本体感觉通路中的病理可能在DM的一般本体感觉性共济失调中发挥重要作用。一些SOD1风险等位基因纯合子的犬并未发展出临床疾病或相关的神经病理学，表明除SOD1突变外，其他因素也影响疾病的发病和进展。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究发表于2026年，聚焦于ALS中常被忽视的感觉通路病理，利用大型动物自然疾病模型，具有直接的ALS转化研究价值。

items.title: Tofersen Treatment in SOD1 -ALS: Real-World Evidence from a Retrospective Multicenter Study in France (FORSLA Study).
items.summary: To evaluate the effectiveness of Tofersen in patients with superoxide dismutase 1 gene ( SOD1-ALS ) patients in France in a real-world setting, using disease progression within patient comparisons and with a historical cohort. Patients with SOD1 -ALS were included from across 19 French FILSLAN network centers. Baseline was defined as the treatment initiation date. Main endpoints were the ALSFRS-R progression rate and plasmatic neurofilament light chain (NfL) levels at baseline and 12 months after baseline. In the Tofersen Cohort (N=46), within-group comparisons showed that the mean ALS functional rating scale revised (ALSFRS-R) progression rate slowed from 0.53 ± 0.5 at baseline to 0.22 ± 0.3 point/month at 12 months ( P =.006). NfL levels significantly decreased from 89.0 ± 9.0 pg/ml at baseline to 29.2 ± 19.5.5 at 12 months ( P =.004). Exploratory comparisons with a propensity score (PS) matched historical cohort (39 matched pairs) using a mixed-effects model, ALSFRS-R progression rate at baseline, 6 months, and 12 months after baseline, showed no statistically significant differences between groups P =.30, whereas longitudinal ALSFRS-R scores differed significantly between groups (time-treatment interaction P =.006). The mean survival of the PS matched population was longer in the Tofersen Cohort (42.6 months) than the Historical Cohort (31.8 months) P =.004. Time-dependent adjusted cox analysis showed that Tofersen was associated with a reduction in mortality risk (adjusted HR=0.34; 95% CI, 0.12-0.91; P =.03). Tofersen seems to be associated with slower functional decline and reduced NfL levels. While limitations of retrospective design and ALSFRS-R sensitivity must be acknowledged, these findings provide real-world evidence suggesting a clinical benefit of Tofersen.

items.titleZh: Tofersen治疗SOD1-ALS：法国多中心回顾性研究的真实世界证据（FORSLA研究）
items.summaryZh: 法国19个中心46名SOD1-ALS患者的真实世界数据显示，接受Tofersen治疗12个月后，功能衰退速度（ALSFRS-R）显著减缓，血液NfL水平显著下降。与匹配的历史对照组相比，Tofersen组生存期更长，死亡风险降低约66%。研究为回顾性设计，存在固有局限性，但为Tofersen在真实临床环境中的获益提供了支持性证据。
items.insight: 这项研究是Tofersen在法国真实世界人群中的首个多中心回顾性证据，补充了临床试验数据，证实了其在常规临床实践中对SOD1-ALS患者功能、生物标志物和生存期的潜在获益，对指导临床决策和后续研究设计具有直接参考价值。

items.abstractZh: 本研究旨在评估Tofersen在法国真实世界环境中对超氧化物歧化酶1基因（SOD1-ALS）患者的疗效，采用患者内疾病进展比较及与历史队列的比较方法。研究纳入了来自法国19个FILSLAN网络中心的SOD1-ALS患者。基线定义为治疗开始日期。主要终点为基线和基线后12个月的ALSFRS-R进展率和血浆神经丝轻链（NfL）水平。在Tofersen队列（N=46）中，组内比较显示，平均ALS功能评定量表修订版（ALSFRS-R）进展率从基线的0.53 ± 0.5点/月减缓至12个月时的0.22 ± 0.3点/月（P = .006）。NfL水平从基线的89.0 ± 9.0 pg/ml显著下降至12个月时的29.2 ± 19.5 pg/ml（P = .004）。与倾向评分（PS）匹配的历史队列（39对匹配）的探索性比较（使用混合效应模型）显示，基线、6个月和12个月后的ALSFRS-R进展率在两组间无统计学显著差异（P = .30），而纵向ALSFRS-R评分在两组间存在显著差异（时间-治疗交互作用P = .006）。PS匹配人群的平均生存期在Tofersen队列（42.6个月）长于历史队列（31.8个月）（P = .004）。时间依赖性校正Cox分析显示，Tofersen与死亡风险降低相关（校正HR=0.34；95% CI，0.12-0.91；P = .03）。Tofersen似乎与较慢的功能衰退和NfL水平降低相关。虽然必须承认回顾性设计和ALSFRS-R敏感性的局限性，但这些发现提供了提示Tofersen临床获益的真实世界证据。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究提供了2026年最新的Tofersen真实世界应用数据，直接关联ALS精准治疗中SOD1亚型的转化价值，并包含生存期获益这一关键临床终点。

items.title: Neutralization of pathogenic PC-OxPL by AAV-delivered scFv as a therapeutic strategy for amyotrophic lateral sclerosis.
items.summary: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) is a fatal neurodegenerative disorder defined by progressive motor neuron loss and TDP-43 proteinopathy, yet the upstream drivers of this pathology remain unclear. Oxidized phosphatidylcholines (PC-OxPL) have emerged as potent inducers of proteinopathy in the central nervous system (CNS), but their role in ALS has not been systematically explored. We identify a distinct PC-OxPL signature in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) of patients with sporadic ALS (sALS) and show that apolipoprotein E (apoE)-containing particles are the primary PC-OxPL carriers in this compartment. In human iPSC-derived motor neurons, PC-OxPL exposure triggered disease-relevant transcriptional alterations and TDP-43 pathology, establishing PC-OxPL as a mediator of ALS-like neurodegeneration in vitro . To counteract this toxicity, we engineered an Adeno-Associated Virus (AAV)-delivered single-chain antibody fragment (scFv), PC-OxPL-VecTab, targeting PC-OxPL neoepitopes. PC-OxPL-VecTab neutralized PC-OxPL-induced neurotoxicity, reduced TDP-43 aggregation, and prevented motor neuron death and behavioral deficits in a sALS CSF transfer mouse model. Intrathecal delivery of PC-OxPL-VecTab in minipigs achieved broad CNS biodistribution and transgene expression, supporting the feasibility of CNS delivery. These findings position PC-OxPL as a mechanistic contributor to ALS pathogenesis and establish PC-OxPL-VecTab as a therapeutic strategy for ALS with potential broader applicability to disorders associated with PC-OxPL accumulation.

items.titleZh: AAV递送的单链抗体中和致病性PC-OxPL作为肌萎缩侧索硬化症的治疗策略
items.summaryZh: 这项研究发现，散发性ALS患者脑脊液中的氧化磷脂酰胆碱（PC-OxPL）水平升高，并可通过含apoE的颗粒携带。在人类运动神经元模型中，PC-OxPL暴露导致TDP-43病理和神经毒性。研究者开发了一种AAV递送的单链抗体（PC-OxPL-VecTab），能够中和PC-OxPL毒性，减少TDP-43聚集，并在小鼠模型中改善运动功能。小型猪实验显示鞘内递送可行。该研究提示PC-OxPL可能是ALS的潜在治疗靶点。
items.insight: 该研究首次系统性地将PC-OxPL与ALS发病机制联系起来，并提供了从患者样本到动物模型再到大型动物递送的完整证据链，为ALS治疗开辟了新的靶点方向，值得关注其后续临床转化进展。

items.abstractZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）是一种以进行性运动神经元丢失和TDP-43蛋白病为特征的致命性神经退行性疾病，但其病理的上游驱动因素仍不清楚。氧化磷脂酰胆碱（PC-OxPL）已被证明是中枢神经系统中蛋白病的强效诱导剂，但其在ALS中的作用尚未被系统探索。我们在散发性ALS（sALS）患者的脑脊液（CSF）中识别出独特的PC-OxPL特征，并显示含载脂蛋白E（apoE）的颗粒是该区域中PC-OxPL的主要载体。在人类iPSC来源的运动神经元中，PC-OxPL暴露触发了疾病相关的转录改变和TDP-43病理，确立了PC-OxPL作为ALS样神经退行性变的体外介质。为对抗这种毒性，我们设计了一种AAV递送的单链抗体片段（scFv）PC-OxPL-VecTab，靶向PC-OxPL新表位。PC-OxPL-VecTab中和了PC-OxPL诱导的神经毒性，减少了TDP-43聚集，并在sALS CSF转移小鼠模型中防止了运动神经元死亡和行为缺陷。在小型猪中鞘内递送PC-OxPL-VecTab实现了广泛的中枢神经系统生物分布和转基因表达，支持CNS递送的可行性。这些发现将PC-OxPL定位为ALS发病机制的机制性贡献者，并确立PC-OxPL-VecTab作为ALS的治疗策略，且可能更广泛适用于与PC-OxPL积累相关的疾病。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究具有高度新近性（2026年发表），直接关联ALS核心病理（TDP-43蛋白病），并展示了从机制到治疗策略的转化价值，包括大型动物递送验证。

items.title: i.c.v. delivery of AAV9-synapsin-promoted caveolin-1 attenuates neuromuscular deficits and neuromuscular degeneration in hSOD1 G93A mice.
items.summary: Practical and broad biodistributable gene delivery interventions are essential for advancing therapeutic strategies targeting neurodegenerative diseases such as amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS). We previously demonstrated that subpial delivery of AAV9-synapsin-promoted caveolin-1 ( SynCav1 ) afforded significant neuroprotective effects in mutant superoxide dismutase (SOD)-1-induced ALS pathology. However, subpial delivery is regionally restricted, technically challenging, and highly invasive. This study evaluated whether the intracerebroventricular (i.c.v.) route of administration (ROA), an alternative CNS delivery strategy less invasive than direct spinal cord injections, could achieve broader CNS biodistribution and produce functional or histological benefits in hSOD1 G93A mice. i.c.v. administration of AAV9- SynCav1 achieved widespread Cav-1 overexpression in the motor cortex and spinal cord. SynCav1 -treated male mice exhibited improved running wheel (RW) performance and better motor-evoked potentials. Immunofluorescence revealed attenuated degeneration of cholinergic motor neurons (MNs) in the cervical and lumbar ventral horn, as well as preserved diaphragm neuromuscular junction (NMJ) innervation in SynCav1- treated mice. These findings serve as preclinical proof of concept that i.c.v. delivery of AAV9- SynCav1 can achieve CNS target engagement and produce selective functional and anatomical benefits in hSOD1 G93A mice.
items.titleZh: 脑室内递送AAV9-synapsin启动子驱动的caveolin-1可减轻hSOD1 G93A小鼠的神经肌肉缺陷和神经肌肉变性
items.summaryZh: 这项研究测试了一种新的基因递送方式——脑室内注射AAV9-SynCav1，用于治疗ALS小鼠模型。结果显示，该方法能有效将治疗基因广泛分布到大脑和脊髓，改善运动功能，并保护运动神经元和神经肌肉接头。相比之前的脊髓注射，脑室内注射创伤更小，且效果显著，为ALS基因治疗提供了更可行的临床转化途径。
items.insight: 该研究为ALS基因治疗提供了更安全、更广泛的递送策略，通过脑室内注射实现全中枢神经系统的基因表达，克服了局部注射的局限性，具有重要的临床转化潜力。

aiRead.keyFinding: 脑室内递送AAV9-SynCav1可实现运动皮层和脊髓的广泛Cav-1过表达，改善运动功能，减轻运动神经元变性和神经肌肉接头去神经支配。
aiRead.limitation: 研究仅在动物模型中进行，未涉及人类受试者；且未报告长期安全性或毒性数据。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注该递送策略在非人灵长类中的安全性和有效性验证，以及SynCav1在其他ALS模型（如C9orf72）中的效果。

items.abstractZh: 实用的、广泛生物分布的基因递送干预对于推进针对肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）等神经退行性疾病的治疗策略至关重要。我们先前证明，蛛网膜下腔递送AAV9-synapsin启动子驱动的caveolin-1（SynCav1）在突变超氧化物歧化酶（SOD1）诱导的ALS病理中具有显著的神经保护作用。然而，蛛网膜下腔递送具有区域限制性、技术挑战性且高度侵入性。本研究评估了脑室内（i.c.v.）给药途径（ROA）——一种比直接脊髓注射侵入性更小的替代性中枢神经系统递送策略——是否能在hSOD1 G93A小鼠中实现更广泛的中枢神经系统生物分布并产生功能或组织学益处。i.c.v.给予AAV9-SynCav1在运动皮层和脊髓中实现了广泛的Cav-1过表达。SynCav1处理的雄性小鼠表现出改善的跑轮（RW）表现和更好的运动诱发电位。免疫荧光显示，SynCav1处理的小鼠颈段和腰段腹角胆碱能运动神经元（MNs）的变性减轻，以及膈肌神经肌肉接头（NMJ）支配得以保留。这些发现作为临床前概念验证，表明i.c.v.递送AAV9-SynCav1可以实现中枢神经系统靶点参与，并在hSOD1 G93A小鼠中产生选择性的功能和解剖学益处。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究采用脑室内递送AAV9-SynCav1，在ALS小鼠模型中实现广泛的中枢神经系统靶向，并展示功能改善，代表了基因治疗递送策略的最新进展，具有直接的ALS转化价值。

items.title: Cell Death in Neurodegenerative Diseases: Molecular Mechanisms and Therapeutic Targets.
items.summary: Neurodegenerative diseases (NDs) are marked by selective neuronal vulnerability and progressive failure of neural circuits. Increasing evidence indicates that neuronal loss is not driven by a single terminal event, but emerges from interacting regulated cell death (RCD) programs. These programs are closely coupled to mitochondrial injury, proteostatic collapse, lysosomal stress, metabolic imbalance, glial state transitions, and chronic neuroinflammation. Yet, how distinct death pathways are organized across cell types, disease stages, and disease-specific microenvironments remains unresolved. This review examines RCD as an integrated pathogenic network in major NDs. Caspase and B-cell lymphoma 2 (BCL2) family signaling, receptor-interacting protein kinase 1 (RIPK1), RIPK3, and mixed lineage kinase domain-like protein activation, NOD-like receptor family pyrin domain containing 3 and gasdermin signaling, GPX4-linked lipid peroxidation control, and autophagy lysosomal failure are discussed as convergent stress response modules rather than isolated pathways. Across Alzheimer's disease, Parkinson's disease, amyotrophic lateral sclerosis, and Huntington's disease, these modules shape neuronal fate through disease-specific interactions with mitochondrial dysfunction, iron dyshomeostasis, inflammasome activation, and microglial metabolic remodeling. We further evaluate emerging therapeutic strategies that target cell death crosstalk, restore autophagy lysosomal competence, or improve delivery to the central nervous system, highlighting the importance of molecular selectivity, cellular context, disease stage, and translational feasibility.
items.titleZh: 神经退行性疾病中的细胞死亡：分子机制与治疗靶点
items.summaryZh: 这篇综述提出，神经退行性疾病中的神经元死亡不是单一事件，而是由多种调节性细胞死亡程序（如凋亡、坏死性凋亡、焦亡、铁死亡和自噬性细胞死亡）相互作用形成的网络。这些程序与线粒体损伤、蛋白稳态失衡、神经炎症等密切相关，并在不同疾病（包括ALS）中呈现特异性组合。文章还讨论了针对这些死亡途径的潜在治疗策略，强调需要根据疾病阶段和细胞类型进行精准干预。
items.insight: 该综述为ALS研究者提供了整合视角，将细胞死亡机制从孤立通路转向网络化调控，有助于理解ALS中运动神经元死亡的复杂性，并为联合靶向治疗策略提供理论基础。

aiRead.keyFinding: 调节性细胞死亡程序在神经退行性疾病中形成相互作用的网络，与线粒体功能障碍、神经炎症等过程协同决定神经元命运。
aiRead.limitation: 作为综述，未提供原始实验数据，且不同死亡途径在具体疾病中的相对贡献仍需进一步验证。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注针对RIPK1或GPX4等关键节点的抑制剂在ALS动物模型中的疗效，以及细胞死亡串扰的生物标志物研究。

items.abstractZh: 神经退行性疾病（NDs）以选择性神经元易损性和神经回路进行性衰竭为特征。越来越多的证据表明，神经元丢失并非由单一终末事件驱动，而是源于相互作用的调节性细胞死亡（RCD）程序。这些程序与线粒体损伤、蛋白稳态崩溃、溶酶体应激、代谢失衡、胶质细胞状态转变和慢性神经炎症密切相关。然而，不同死亡途径如何在细胞类型、疾病阶段和疾病特异性微环境中组织仍不清楚。本综述将RCD视为主要神经退行性疾病中的整合致病网络。讨论了半胱天冬酶和B细胞淋巴瘤2（BCL2）家族信号、受体相互作用蛋白激酶1（RIPK1）、RIPK3和混合谱系激酶结构域样蛋白激活、NOD样受体家族含pyrin结构域蛋白3和gasdermin信号、GPX4相关的脂质过氧化控制以及自噬溶酶体衰竭，这些被视为汇聚的应激反应模块而非孤立途径。在阿尔茨海默病、帕金森病、肌萎缩侧索硬化症和亨廷顿病中，这些模块通过与线粒体功能障碍、铁稳态失调、炎症小体激活和小胶质细胞代谢重塑的疾病特异性相互作用来塑造神经元命运。我们进一步评估了针对细胞死亡串扰、恢复自噬溶酶体能力或改善中枢神经系统递送的新兴治疗策略，强调了分子选择性、细胞背景、疾病阶段和转化可行性的重要性。
items.frontierRationale: 该综述发表于2026年，系统整合了最新细胞死亡机制研究，直接关联ALS等疾病的病理过程，并探讨了新兴治疗靶点，具有较高的转化价值。

items.title: Gut microbiota and brain health: Disease-specific pathways and emerging therapeutic strategies.
items.summary: The microbiota-gut-brain axis (MGBA) has emerged as a dynamic, bidirectional communication system linking the gastrointestinal tract and the central nervous system (CNS) through neural, immune, endocrine, and metabolic mechanisms. Increasing evidence indicates that alterations in gut microbial communities are associated with a wide range of neurological disorders; however, the strength of this association varies across diseases, and many mechanistic observations still rely predominantly on experimental models rather than human studies. This review provides an overview of current evidence regarding the role of the gut microbiota in maintaining CNS homeostasis, with particular emphasis on intestinal barrier function, immune modulation, vagal and enteric communication, and the generation of biologically active microbial metabolites, including short-chain fatty acids, bile acids, and neurotransmitter-related compounds. Studies in both clinical and experimental settings have reported disease-specific microbial signatures in conditions such as Alzheimer's disease, Parkinson's disease, multiple sclerosis, autism spectrum disorders, and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis. In parallel, microbiota-directed interventions-including probiotics, prebiotics, dietary approaches, fecal microbiota transplantation, and strategies targeting microbial metabolites-have produced encouraging findings in preclinical studies and early-stage clinical investigations. Nevertheless, considerable heterogeneity in study populations, experimental methodologies, and therapeutic protocols continues to limit the translation of these findings into routine clinical practice. Collectively, current evidence supports the MGBA as a valuable framework for understanding neurological diseases while underscoring the need for rigorously designed longitudinal studies and well-controlled clinical trials to define its therapeutic relevance better.
items.titleZh: 肠道微生物群与大脑健康：疾病特异性通路与新兴治疗策略
items.summaryZh: 这篇综述系统梳理了肠道微生物群通过肠-脑轴影响中枢神经系统健康的证据，涵盖神经、免疫、内分泌和代谢通路。文章指出，在ALS等多种神经退行性疾病中已观察到疾病特异性的肠道菌群特征，但多数机制证据仍来自动物模型。针对菌群的干预策略（如益生菌、饮食调整、粪菌移植）在早期研究中显示出潜力，但距离临床应用仍有较大距离。
items.insight: 对ALS研究者而言，这篇综述的价值在于将ALS纳入肠-脑轴研究的整体框架，提示肠道菌群特征可能成为ALS的疾病标志物或治疗靶点。文章强调的"疾病特异性微生物特征"概念，为ALS与其他神经退行性疾病的鉴别诊断和个体化治疗提供了新思路，同时提醒研究者注意从动物模型向人类转化时的证据等级问题。

aiRead.keyFinding: 肠道微生物群通过多种机制影响中枢神经系统，在ALS等疾病中观察到疾病特异性菌群特征，菌群靶向干预在临床前和早期临床研究中显示潜力。
aiRead.limitation: 多数机制证据来自实验模型而非人类研究；研究人群、方法和方案存在显著异质性，限制了结果的普适性和临床转化。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注针对ALS的纵向肠道菌群队列研究，以及靶向微生物代谢产物（如短链脂肪酸）的干预性临床试验结果。

items.abstractZh: 微生物群-肠-脑轴（MGBA）已成为一个动态的双向通讯系统，通过神经、免疫、内分泌和代谢机制将胃肠道与中枢神经系统（CNS）联系起来。越来越多的证据表明，肠道微生物群落的改变与多种神经系统疾病相关；然而，这种关联的强度因疾病而异，许多机制性观察仍主要依赖于实验模型而非人类研究。本综述概述了关于肠道微生物群在维持中枢神经系统稳态中作用的现有证据，特别强调肠道屏障功能、免疫调节、迷走神经和肠神经系统通讯，以及具有生物活性的微生物代谢产物（包括短链脂肪酸、胆汁酸和神经递质相关化合物）的产生。临床和实验环境中的研究均报告了在阿尔茨海默病、帕金森病、多发性硬化症、自闭症谱系障碍和肌萎缩侧索硬化等疾病中具有疾病特异性的微生物特征。与此同时，针对微生物群的干预措施——包括益生菌、益生元、饮食方法、粪便微生物群移植以及针对微生物代谢产物的策略——在临床前研究和早期临床研究中已产生令人鼓舞的发现。然而，研究人群、实验方法和治疗方案方面的显著异质性继续限制着这些发现向常规临床实践的转化。总的来说，现有证据支持MGBA作为理解神经系统疾病的一个有价值的框架，同时强调需要严格设计的纵向研究和良好对照的临床试验，以更好地确定其治疗相关性。
items.frontierRationale: 该综述发表于2026年，系统整合了肠-脑轴在ALS等神经退行性疾病中的最新研究进展，突出了微生物代谢产物作为潜在治疗靶点的转化价值。

items.title: Association of Military Branch and Rank With Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis Incidence Among United States Veterans.
items.summary: Military service is one of the most consistent risk factors for the development of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS), but little is known about what aspects of military service matter. Understanding the distribution of ALS risk in military personnel may help identify key risk factors. We aimed to ascertain the association of United States (US) military branch and rank with incident ALS. We conducted a longitudinal cohort study including all veterans with a Veterans Health Administration encounter from January 1, 2000, through October 1, 2024, and more than 2 years of follow-up. Incident ALS was identified through medical records. Exposures included military branch (Army, Navy, Air Force, Marine Corps, Coast Guard, or multiple branches), military rank (officer, enlisted, or both), and length of service. Risk was estimated with Cox proportional hazards models, controlled for age, adjusted for race/ethnicity, and stratified by sex. The analytic sample comprised 9,157,938 men (13,935 incident ALS cases, mean age = 56.9 years) and 784,941 women (484 cases, mean age = 42.4 at start of follow up). Among men, compared with service in the Army, service in the Air Force (hazard ratio [HR] = 1.29, 95% CI 1.23-1.35), Navy (HR = 1.15, 95% CI 1.10-1.20), and Coast Guard (HR = 1.26, 95% CI 1.06-1.50) was associated with higher rates of ALS and service in the Marines a lower rate (HR = 0.78, 95% CI 0.68-0.88). Officers had higher rates than enlisted personnel (men, HR = 1.64, 95% CI 1.53-1.74; women, HR = 1.72, 95% CI 1.31-2.27). Longer service was associated with lower rates of ALS. In age-stratified models, differences in hazard rates between Army veterans and Air Force, Navy, and Coast Guard veterans were greatest for the youngest men (17-61 years, HR range = 1.26 to 1.51) and smallest for the oldest (>75-104 years, HR range = 0.99 to 1.12). ALS rates varied considerably by branch and rank in the US military, with larger differences among younger veterans. Officers and those serving in the Air Force, Navy, or Coast Guard may incur exposure to military environments that increase risk of ALS. It is imperative to identify relevant exposures to reduce harm to service members and, potentially, civilians with similar exposures.
items.titleZh: 美国退伍军人中军种和军衔与肌萎缩侧索硬化发病率的关联
items.summaryZh: 这项大型美国退伍军人队列研究发现，不同军种和军衔的ALS发病率存在显著差异。空军、海军和海岸警卫队服役者ALS风险高于陆军，而海军陆战队风险较低；军官风险高于士兵。年轻退伍军人中的差异更为明显。研究提示特定军事环境暴露可能增加ALS风险。
items.insight: 该研究基于超过900万退伍军人的大规模纵向数据，首次系统描绘了军种和军衔与ALS风险的关联模式，为缩小ALS军事相关风险因素的范围、指导后续暴露识别研究提供了关键流行病学线索。

aiRead.keyFinding: 空军、海军和海岸警卫队服役及军官身份与更高的ALS发病率相关，且年轻退伍军人中差异更显著。
aiRead.limitation: 观察性设计无法确立因果关系；未测量具体环境暴露；退伍军人健康管理局数据可能未覆盖所有退伍军人；女性病例数较少。
aiRead.watchNext: 后续研究应聚焦于识别与特定军种和军衔相关的具体暴露因素（如化学物质、电磁场、职业任务等），并验证其在平民人群中的相关性。

items.abstractZh: 服兵役是肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）最一致的风险因素之一，但关于军事服务的哪些方面重要，目前知之甚少。了解军人中ALS风险的分布可能有助于识别关键风险因素。我们旨在确定美国（US）军种和军衔与偶发ALS的关联。我们进行了一项纵向队列研究，纳入2000年1月1日至2024年10月1日期间所有在退伍军人健康管理局有就诊记录且随访超过2年的退伍军人。偶发ALS通过医疗记录识别。暴露因素包括军种（陆军、海军、空军、海军陆战队、海岸警卫队或多个军种）、军衔（军官、士兵或两者）以及服役年限。风险使用Cox比例风险模型估计，控制年龄，调整种族/民族，并按性别分层。分析样本包括9,157,938名男性（13,935例偶发ALS病例，平均年龄56.9岁）和784,941名女性（484例病例，随访开始时平均年龄42.4岁）。在男性中，与陆军服役相比，空军（风险比[HR]=1.29，95% CI 1.23-1.35）、海军（HR=1.15，95% CI 1.10-1.20）和海岸警卫队（HR=1.26，95% CI 1.06-1.50）服役与更高的ALS发病率相关，而海军陆战队服役与较低发病率相关（HR=0.78，95% CI 0.68-0.88）。军官的发病率高于士兵（男性，HR=1.64，95% CI 1.53-1.74；女性，HR=1.72，95% CI 1.31-2.27）。较长的服役期与较低的ALS发病率相关。在按年龄分层的模型中，陆军退伍军人与空军、海军和海岸警卫队退伍军人之间的风险差异在年轻男性（17-61岁，HR范围=1.26至1.51）中最大，在年长男性（>75-104岁，HR范围=0.99至1.12）中最小。美国军队中ALS发病率因军种和军衔而异，年轻退伍军人中的差异更大。军官以及在空军、海军或海岸警卫队服役的人员可能暴露于增加ALS风险的军事环境中。识别相关暴露以减少对服役人员以及可能具有类似暴露的平民的伤害至关重要。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究利用近25年的大规模退伍军人队列数据，揭示了军种和军衔这一此前未被细化的ALS风险维度，具有直接的ALS病因学转化价值。

items.title: TDP-43-Associated Neurodegenerative Disease Conceptualization and Integrated Staging: A Review.
items.summary: Classifying disease based on underlying pathobiology rather than clinical phenotype has implications for the development of biomarkers and therapy development. Transactive response DNA-binding protein 43 kDa (TDP-43) pathology is observed across a range of clinically defined neurodegenerative disorders including limbic predominant age-related encephalopathy (LATE), most cases of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS), inclusion body myositis, multisystem proteinopathy, and approximately half the cases of frontotemporal dementia (FTD). Despite this shared biology, the current nosology for these neurodegenerative disorders is based on their distinct clinical phenotypes. An alternative approach recognizes the central role of TDP-43 pathology in disease pathogenesis, reserving the use of clinical terms like ALS, FTD, or LATE to describe phenotypic manifestations of underlying pathobiology. This approach also recognizes the converging biomarker and neuropathological data indicating that pathology begins presymptomatically, before the overt clinical manifestations of disease appear. In proposing a pathobiological definition of disease, the goal is to provide a road map for developing biomarkers that accurately reflect the underlying pathobiology of disease and for advancing therapeutic candidates that effectively target fundamental disease mechanisms.
items.titleZh: TDP-43相关神经退行性疾病的概念化与整合分期：综述
items.summaryZh: 这篇综述提出，应基于TDP-43病理生物学而非临床表型来重新定义和分类神经退行性疾病，如ALS、FTD和LATE。作者认为，TDP-43病理是这些疾病的共同核心机制，且病理变化在临床症状出现前就已存在。这种概念化有助于开发更准确的生物标志物和针对根本机制的疗法。
items.insight: 该综述为ALS研究者提供了重要的概念框架，强调TDP-43病理作为跨疾病共同机制的核心地位，可能推动生物标志物和治疗策略的范式转变，从针对临床表型转向靶向病理生物学。

aiRead.keyFinding: 提出以TDP-43病理生物学为核心，重新定义和分期神经退行性疾病，强调病理早于临床症状。
aiRead.limitation: 作为观点性综述，缺乏原始数据支持，且整合分期框架尚未经过临床验证。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注后续关于TDP-43病理分期标准的具体提案，以及基于该框架开发的生物标志物研究。

items.abstractZh: 基于潜在病理生物学而非临床表型对疾病进行分类，对生物标志物的开发和治疗方法的研发具有重要意义。反式激活反应DNA结合蛋白43 kDa（TDP-43）病理可见于一系列临床定义的神经退行性疾病，包括边缘系统为主的年龄相关脑病（LATE）、大多数肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）病例、包涵体肌炎、多系统蛋白病，以及约一半的额颞叶痴呆（FTD）病例。尽管存在这种共同的生物学基础，目前这些神经退行性疾病的分类体系仍基于其不同的临床表型。另一种方法则认识到TDP-43病理在疾病发病机制中的核心作用，将ALS、FTD或LATE等临床术语保留用于描述潜在病理生物学的表型表现。该方法还认识到，汇聚的生物标志物和神经病理学数据表明，病理在症状出现前即已开始，早于疾病的明显临床表现。在提出疾病的病理生物学定义时，目标是提供一张路线图，用于开发准确反映疾病潜在病理生物学的生物标志物，并推进有效靶向基本疾病机制的治疗候选药物。
items.frontierRationale: 该综述发表于2026年，提出基于TDP-43病理生物学的疾病重新定义和整合分期，直接关联ALS的病理机制和转化研究，具有高度的新近性和转化价值。

items.title: Decoding the Neuroinflammatory Potential of Non-Nutritive Sweeteners Through An Integrative Computational Approach.
items.summary: Non-nutritive sweeteners (NNS) are commonly used in the beverage, food, and pharmaceutical industries, however, their possible link to neuroinflammation remains a contentious issue. Hence, to investigate this potential association and identify the molecular pathways involved, targets of the most frequently consumed NNSs, namely sucralose, aspartame, acesulfame, cyclamate, and saccharin, were extracted from the STITCH, Super-PRED, STP, SEA and CTD databases, while neuroinflammatory targets were extracted from GeneCards, OMIM, and NCBI databases. A total of 124 targets were obtained by overlapping NNS and neuroinflammatory targets, of which 20 key targets, including CASP3, PPARγ, MTOR, and MMP9, were identified for further analysis. KEGG enrichment analysis suggested a significant association of these targets with pathways related to Alzheimer's disease and neuroactive ligand-receptor interaction. Gene Ontology analysis revealed enrichment in biological processes associated with inflammatory response and reactive oxygen species. The associated cellular components were primarily localised in the axon, dendrite, and synaptic membrane. Molecular docking followed by molecular dynamics simulations was performed to evaluate the stability of the NNS-key target complexes, revealing favourable binding affinities and stable interaction profiles. Gene expression analysis of these key targets predicted their differential regulation across four majorly recognised neuroinflammatory disorders, including Alzheimer's disease, multiple sclerosis, Parkinson's disease, and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis, with a significant up or downregulation of these key targets. Results of this study suggest that NNS may be associated with neuroinflammatory processes through these key targets and identified pathways, highlighting the need for improving the standards in food safety.
items.titleZh: 通过整合计算方法解码非营养性甜味剂的神经炎症潜力
items.summaryZh: 这项计算研究通过整合数据库、分子对接和动力学模拟，发现常见非营养性甜味剂（如三氯蔗糖、阿斯巴甜）的靶点与神经炎症相关蛋白（如CASP3、PPARγ、MTOR、MMP9）存在相互作用，并预测这些靶点在ALS等神经炎症疾病中表达异常。研究提示甜味剂可能通过特定分子通路影响神经炎症，但仅为计算预测，需实验验证。
items.insight: 该研究首次系统性地将非营养性甜味剂与ALS等神经炎症疾病的分子靶点联系起来，为环境因素在ALS发病中的潜在作用提供了新的计算证据，值得关注其后续实验验证和流行病学关联研究。

aiRead.studyType: 计算生物学研究（数据库挖掘、分子对接、分子动力学模拟）
aiRead.keyFinding: 非营养性甜味剂靶点与神经炎症靶点重叠出20个关键基因，富集于阿尔茨海默病通路，且这些基因在ALS等疾病中差异表达。
aiRead.limitation: 纯计算预测，缺乏实验验证；数据库依赖可能引入偏差；未考虑甜味剂体内代谢和剂量效应。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注后续是否开展细胞或动物实验验证甜味剂对关键靶点（如CASP3、PPARγ）的调控，以及流行病学研究探索甜味剂摄入与ALS风险的关系。

items.abstractZh: 非营养性甜味剂（NNS）常用于饮料、食品和制药行业，然而它们与神经炎症的可能关联仍存在争议。因此，为研究这种潜在关联并识别涉及的分子通路，从STITCH、Super-PRED、STP、SEA和CTD数据库中提取了最常消费的NNS（即三氯蔗糖、阿斯巴甜、安赛蜜、环己基氨基磺酸盐和糖精）的靶点，同时从GeneCards、OMIM和NCBI数据库中提取神经炎症靶点。通过重叠NNS和神经炎症靶点，共获得124个靶点，其中20个关键靶点（包括CASP3、PPARγ、MTOR和MMP9）被确定用于进一步分析。KEGG富集分析表明这些靶点与阿尔茨海默病和神经活性配体-受体相互作用相关的通路显著关联。基因本体论分析显示在炎症反应和活性氧相关的生物过程中富集。相关细胞组分主要定位于轴突、树突和突触膜。进行了分子对接和分子动力学模拟以评估NNS-关键靶点复合物的稳定性，显示出良好的结合亲和力和稳定的相互作用谱。这些关键靶点的基因表达分析预测它们在四种主要公认的神经炎症疾病（包括阿尔茨海默病、多发性硬化、帕金森病和肌萎缩侧索硬化）中差异调控，这些关键靶点显著上调或下调。本研究结果表明，NNS可能通过这些关键靶点和已识别的通路与神经炎症过程相关，强调需要提高食品安全标准。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究采用整合计算方法（2026年发表）探索常见食品添加剂与ALS等神经炎症疾病的分子关联，具有转化价值，可能为ALS的环境风险因素提供新线索。

items.title: Theory of mind impairment related to C9orf72 repeat expansion in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis: a case-control study.
items.summary: Objective : To investigate cognitive and affective theory of mind (ToM) in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) patients carrying the C9orf72 repeat expansion (C9orf72+), compared with matched non-mutated (C9orf72-) ALS patients and healthy controls (HCs). Methods : We assessed 34 C9orf72+ ALS patients, 34 C9orf72- ALS patients matched for sex, age, education, and cognitive category, and 34 HC matched for sex, age, and education. Participants underwent neuropsychological evaluation, including the Story-Based Empathy Task (SET), assessing cognitive ToM (Intention Attribution, IA), affective ToM (Emotion Attribution, EA), and Causal Inference (CI). Results : C9orf72+ patients showed lower SET-global score than C9orf72- patients ( p = 0.028). Compared with HC, C9orf72+ showed lower score in SET-global score and all SET subtests (all p < 0.05). C9orf72+ cognitively normal differed from HC in SET-global score, IA, and EA (all p < 0.038), whereas C9orf72- cognitively normal did not differ from HC. Multiple linear regression analyses indicated that ALS-specific cognitive domains only explained ∼25% of ToM variance, with no association with demographic, clinical, or behavioral variables. Cluster analysis identified three cognitive profiles based on SET performance, with the most impaired cluster showing the highest proportion of C9orf72+ patients (68%). Conclusion: C9orf72 -mutated ALS patients showed more pronounced impairment in cognitive and affective ToM than non-mutated ALS patients, independent of demographic, clinical, and cognitive features. These findings, although requiring confirmation on larger samples, suggest that ToM dysfunction may represent a sensitive marker of cognitive involvement in ALS- C9orf72 -associated disease, particularly in its affective component.
items.evidenceLevel: 观察性临床研究（病例对照）
items.titleZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化中与C9orf72重复扩增相关的心理理论损害：一项病例对照研究
items.summaryZh: 这项病例对照研究发现，携带C9orf72重复扩增的ALS患者在心理理论（理解他人意图和情绪的能力）方面比不携带该突变的ALS患者受损更严重，且这种差异与年龄、教育程度、疾病严重程度等无关。即使认知测试正常的C9orf72突变患者，其心理理论能力也已出现下降。聚类分析显示，心理理论受损最严重的患者群体中，68%为C9orf72突变携带者。研究者认为，心理理论测试，特别是情感成分，可能成为ALS-C9orf72相关疾病认知受累的敏感标志。
items.insight: 该研究提示心理理论（ToM）功能障碍可能是C9orf72相关ALS中一个独立于经典认知评估的早期敏感标志，尤其情感ToM成分值得在临床评估和未来干预试验中作为候选结局指标关注。

aiRead.keyFinding: C9orf72+ ALS患者在认知和情感ToM上均比C9orf72-患者和健康对照更差，且独立于人口学和临床特征；认知正常的C9orf72+患者也已出现ToM损害。
aiRead.limitation: 样本量较小（每组34例），且为横断面设计，无法确定ToM损害的时间进程；ToM变异中仍有约75%未被模型解释。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注更大样本的纵向研究，以验证ToM损害是否先于其他认知症状出现，以及其与FTD转化的关联；同时可关注ToM测试在C9orf72临床试验中作为认知结局指标的可行性。

items.abstractZh: 目的：比较携带C9orf72重复扩增的肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）患者（C9orf72+）与匹配的非突变ALS患者（C9orf72-）及健康对照（HC）在认知和情感心理理论（ToM）方面的表现。方法：评估了34名C9orf72+ ALS患者、34名在性别、年龄、教育程度和认知类别上匹配的C9orf72- ALS患者，以及34名在性别、年龄和教育程度上匹配的健康对照。参与者接受了神经心理学评估，包括基于故事的同理心任务（SET），该任务评估认知心理理论（意图归因，IA）、情感心理理论（情绪归因，EA）和因果推断（CI）。结果：C9orf72+患者的SET总分低于C9orf72-患者（p = 0.028）。与健康对照相比，C9orf72+患者在SET总分及所有SET子测试中得分较低（所有p < 0.05）。认知正常的C9orf72+患者在SET总分、IA和EA方面与健康对照存在差异（所有p < 0.038），而认知正常的C9orf72-患者与健康对照无差异。多元线性回归分析表明，ALS特异性认知领域仅解释了约25%的ToM方差，且与人口统计学、临床或行为变量无关。聚类分析基于SET表现确定了三种认知谱，其中受损最严重的聚类中C9orf72+患者比例最高（68%）。结论：携带C9orf72突变的ALS患者在认知和情感ToM方面表现出比非突变ALS患者更明显的损害，且与人口统计学、临床和认知特征无关。这些发现虽然需要在更大样本中确认，但提示ToM功能障碍可能代表ALS-C9orf72相关疾病中认知受累的敏感标志物，尤其是在其情感成分方面。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究发表于2026年，聚焦C9orf72突变这一ALS/FTD谱系关键遗传因素，提出ToM作为独立于传统认知域的敏感标志物，具有直接的临床转化评估价值。

items.title: Glycolysis as a central pathological axis in neurodegenerative diseases.
items.summary: Glycolysis is increasingly recognized as a pathological backbone in neurodegenerative diseases rather than merely an accompanying epiphenomenon. This article first delineates the division of metabolic labor among neurons, astrocytes, microglia, and oligodendrocytes in the brain, with particular emphasis on cell type-specific glycolytic flux, lactate shuttling, and an integrated brain-periphery framework of energy metabolism. It then systematically compares alterations in glucose uptake, glycolytic intermediates, and lactate metabolism across Alzheimer disease (AD), Parkinson disease (PD), amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS), Wilson disease (WD), Huntington's disease (HD), and multiple sclerosis (MS), highlighting pronounced heterogeneity across cell types, disease stages, and brain regions. These metabolic disturbances encompass not only global cerebral hypometabolism and an energy crisis, but also compensatory hyperglycolysis and inflammation-associated metabolic reprogramming in astrocytes and microglia, and extend further to systemic metabolic phenotypes involving peripheral blood cells, muscle, and liver. The article summarizes recent methodological advances for characterizing glycolytic reprogramming, including fluorodeoxyglucose positron emission tomography (FDG-PET), hyperpolarized carbon-13 magnetic resonance spectroscopy(ˆ13C-MRS), metabolomics, single-cell and spatial transcriptomics, genetically encoded metabolic sensors, and Seahorse assays. In addition, potential therapeutic strategies are discussed, focusing on targets such as 6-phosphofructo-2-kinase/fructose-2,6-bisphosphatase 3(PFKFB3), the astrocyte-neuron lactate shuttle (ANLS), microglial glycolysis and lactylation, as well as systemic metabolic modulation and nanodelivery approaches. Finally, key challenges are highlighted, including unclear causal relationships, biphasic and cell type-specific effects, insufficient brain-periphery integration, and the lack of standardized metrics, underscoring the need for longitudinal, multimodal, and stage-specific strategies to reposition glycolysis as a targetable therapeutic dimension in neurodegenerative diseases.
items.evidenceLevel: 综述（动物/细胞实验证据）
items.titleZh: 糖酵解作为神经退行性疾病的核心病理轴
items.summaryZh: 这篇综述提出糖酵解是神经退行性疾病（包括ALS）的核心病理轴，而非仅仅是伴随现象。文章比较了多种疾病中糖酵解的改变，指出代谢紊乱具有细胞类型和阶段特异性，并涉及脑与外周的互动。同时总结了最新的代谢研究方法（如FDG-PET、单细胞转录组等）和潜在治疗靶点（如PFKFB3、ANLS等），强调需要纵向、多模态的研究来明确因果关系。
items.insight: 该综述将糖酵解提升为神经退行性疾病的共同病理轴，为ALS研究提供了新的代谢视角，提示针对细胞特异性糖酵解通路的干预可能成为治疗策略，值得ALS研究者关注。

aiRead.keyFinding: 糖酵解在神经退行性疾病中呈现细胞类型和阶段特异性的改变，包括代偿性高糖酵解和炎症相关代谢重编程，并涉及脑-外周互动。

items.abstractZh: 糖酵解日益被认为是神经退行性疾病的病理基础，而不仅仅是伴随的表象。本文首先阐述了大脑中神经元、星形胶质细胞、小胶质细胞和少突胶质细胞之间的代谢分工，特别强调了细胞类型特异性的糖酵解通量、乳酸穿梭以及脑-外周能量代谢的整体框架。随后，系统比较了阿尔茨海默病（AD）、帕金森病（PD）、肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）、威尔逊病（WD）、亨廷顿病（HD）和多发性硬化（MS）中葡萄糖摄取、糖酵解中间产物和乳酸代谢的变化，突出了细胞类型、疾病阶段和脑区之间的显著异质性。这些代谢紊乱不仅包括整体脑代谢减退和能量危机，还包括星形胶质细胞和小胶质细胞中代偿性高糖酵解和炎症相关的代谢重编程，并进一步扩展到涉及外周血细胞、肌肉和肝脏的系统性代谢表型。文章总结了表征糖酵解重编程的最新方法学进展，包括氟脱氧葡萄糖正电子发射断层扫描（FDG-PET）、超极化碳-13磁共振波谱（13C-MRS）、代谢组学、单细胞和空间转录组学、基因编码代谢传感器以及Seahorse分析。此外，还讨论了潜在的治疗策略，重点关注6-磷酸果糖-2-激酶/果糖-2,6-二磷酸酶3（PFKB3）、星形胶质细胞-神经元乳酸穿梭（ANLS）、小胶质细胞糖酵解和乳酸化，以及系统性代谢调节和纳米递送方法。最后，强调了关键挑战，包括因果关系不明确、双相和细胞类型特异性效应、脑-外周整合不足以及缺乏标准化指标，强调了纵向、多模态和阶段特异性策略的必要性，以将糖酵解重新定位为神经退行性疾病中可靶向的治疗维度。

items.title: Translating neurofilament light chain testing into clinical practice: a multidisciplinary implementation roadmap.
items.summary: Neurofilament light chain (NfL) has been identified as a sensitive and broadly validated biomarker of neuroaxonal injury across multiple neurological conditions, including multiple sclerosis (MS), amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS), Alzheimer's disease (AD), and atypical parkinsonian syndromes. This position paper provides a multidisciplinary roadmap for translating circulating NfL testing into routine clinical practice, integrating analytical, interpretative, and organizational dimensions. It summarizes the biological basis and clinical evidence supporting NfL as a diagnostic, prognostic, and monitoring tool, emphasizing its high sensitivity to neuroaxonal injury across both acute inflammatory and chronic degenerative processes. Comparative analysis of immunoassay technologies identifies strengths and critical sources of variability, while operational guidelines highlight the need for pre-analytical standardization, inter-laboratory harmonization, and participation in quality control schemes. Confounders such as age, BMI, renal function, and comorbidities are shown to significantly influence interpretation, supporting the use of age-adjusted Z-scores, percentiles, and longitudinal normalization for accurate patient-level evaluation. From a clinical standpoint, the paper focuses on practical indications for NfL testing in MS, recommending its use for disease activity prediction and monitoring, treatment decisions and treatment response assessment. Integration of blood NfL with magnetic resonance imaging (MRI), glial fibrillary acidic protein (GFAP) and other biomarkers measurement is proposed as a core strategy for biomarker-driven precision neurology. The authors outline an implementation model encompassing laboratory validation, structured reporting and alignment with national neurological care pathways. They conclude that the transition of NfL into clinical use requires harmonized analytical procedures, interdisciplinary education, and sustainable governance frameworks. Priority actions include regulatory qualification, establishment of international reference materials, and development of pragmatic real-world trials to consolidate its clinical utility. When these measures are achieved, NfL will represent a cornerstone biomarker for precision neurology and neurodegeneration monitoring.

items.abstractZh: 神经丝轻链（NfL）已被确定为多种神经系统疾病（包括多发性硬化症（MS）、肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）、阿尔茨海默病（AD）和非典型帕金森综合征）中神经轴突损伤的敏感且广泛验证的生物标志物。本立场文件提供了将循环NfL检测转化为常规临床实践的多学科路线图，整合了分析、解释和组织层面的考量。文章总结了支持NfL作为诊断、预后和监测工具的生物基础及临床证据，强调其对急性炎症和慢性退行性过程中神经轴突损伤的高敏感性。免疫分析技术的比较分析指出了其优势及变异性的关键来源，而操作指南则强调了分析前标准化、实验室间协调以及参与质量控制计划的必要性。年龄、BMI、肾功能和合并症等混杂因素被证明显著影响解释，支持使用年龄调整的Z分数、百分位数和纵向标准化进行准确的患者个体化评估。从临床角度看，该文件聚焦于NfL检测在MS中的实用指征，推荐将其用于疾病活动预测和监测、治疗决策及治疗反应评估。将血液NfL与磁共振成像（MRI）、胶质纤维酸性蛋白（GFAP）及其他生物标志物测量相结合，被提议作为生物标志物驱动的精准神经病学的核心策略。作者概述了一个实施模型，涵盖实验室验证、结构化报告以及与国家神经护理路径的对接。他们得出结论，NfL向临床应用的过渡需要协调的分析程序、跨学科教育和可持续的治理框架。优先行动包括监管资格认定、建立国际参考物质以及开展务实的真实世界试验以巩固其临床效用。当这些措施实现后，NfL将成为精准神经病学和神经退行性疾病监测的基石生物标志物。

items.title: A de novo FUS frameshift variant (p.Gly501Valfs*30) presenting with tremor and prominent extrapyramidal features in young-onset motor neuron disease: a case report.
items.summary: Fused in sarcoma ( FUS ) mutations are a recognized cause of juvenile-onset amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS), typically associated with early age at onset and rapid disease progression. Here we report a 32-year-old Chinese man who presented with bilateral hand tremor as the initial symptom, followed by progressive dysarthria, bradykinesia, and multi-segment upper and lower motor neuron involvement. Whole-exome sequencing identified a de novo heterozygous FUS frameshift (p.Gly501Valfs*30), confirmed absent in both parents. Electromyography revealed predominantly chronic neurogenic changes. At approximately 2.5 years from symptom onset, the patient remains ambulatory with a walking frame, with a notably milder course than the previously reported frameshift at the same Gly501 codon. This case expands the phenotypic spectrum of FUS -associated motor neuron disease and highlights tremor and extrapyramidal features as potential early manifestations in adult patients.
